title: A leap second written in a negative offset
why: `2016-12-31T18:59:60-05:00` is the same instant as `2016-12-31T23:59:60Z` — New York rather than Tokyo. Its `+09:00` sibling cannot pin the sign: an engine that adds the offset magnitude whichever way it points reaches `23:59:60` from `+09:00` by luck and lands on `13:59:60` here, refusing a legal timestamp. Both signs, or the branch is untested.
